source_algebra.actual_order2_advection: Tx=-msftx*rdx*[ru_right*(chi_right+chi)/2 - ru_left*(chi+chi_left)/2]; y term analogously uses msftx*rdy. Vertical rom=0 makes its initialized flux contribution zero.
source_algebra.RK_coupling: rk_update_scalar uses T=advect_tend*msfty+sc_tend and chi_new=[(c1*(mu_old+mu_base)+c2)*chi_old+dt*T]/[c1*(mu_new+mu_base)+c2]. Thus effective horizontal metric factor is msftx*msfty.
source_algebra.independent_ledger: For manufactured c1/c2 constant in horizontal space at each level, A=1/(msftx*msfty), W=c1*mu_total+c2, Mlayer=-dnw*W/g. Per-cell flux identity implies delta(sum A*Mlayer*chi) is the periodic net face flux, zero with matching endpoints. Cell dx*dy may be set1 or retained as a common area factor.
source_algebra.continuity: With rdx=1 and G already a metric-coupled face column-mass flux, mu_total_new=mu_total_old-dt*(msftx*msfty)*(G_right-G_left). ru=c1*G+c2*Uconst yields matching layer-mass divergence because delta(Uconst)=0. For rdx!=1 include rdx explicitly.
source_algebra.physical_velocity_caveat: Native big-step coupling uses ru=u*(c1*muu+c2)/msfu (module_big_step_utilities_em.F:372). Manufactured G/Uconst are flux inputs; do not call them authenticated primitive winds without that metric/mass relation.

required_wiring_and_oracle_constraints.requirement: For two independent scalars compute each advection tendency from its own field and call the update per index. A multi-scalar call using one patterned advect_tend is invalid.

required_wiring_and_oracle_constraints.requirement: Supply fully mass-coupled T to sc_tend once, verify tendency reset, and label this as scalar-update coverage. This does not exercise advect_scalar_pd or prove PD advection/positivity.

Set rk_step1 with scalar_2 as old state and verify scalar_1 copy, or separately declare a later-RK arm using scalar_1. Include mu_base in both weights; initialize all branches dummy inputs. Budget only owned i<=ide-1,j<=jde-1,k<=kde-1 cells, excluding halos/top interface.

Constant nonunit maps are a global area scale; total conservation alone cannot discriminate missing map factors. Require per-cell independent flux/update and uniform-tracer preservation against matching mass continuity. A varying-map arm is optional additional evidence, not inferred coverage.

Raw sum need not change for uniform tracer. Demonstrate raw-sum nonconservation only in a deliberate nonuniform/changing-mass discriminating arm. Require positive new layer masses and finite outputs; no arbitrary clipping.

Hash exact extracted procedures/IF block and recover byte-identical source without physics edits. Minimal wrapper/config adapters, error stubs and shape/initialization are distinct authored artifacts. Full procedure compilation is not full module or WRF host compilation.
